description: Expressive Island — redesigned system event experiences, more adaptive expanded islands, clearer permissions, and improved assistant and settings interfaces
features: Added dedicated Microphone permission support for Assistant voice input, including permission status and request controls in the Permissions tab
Added detailed permission explanations for microphone access and updated accessibility-service guidance

Added categorized System Events settings to make event controls easier to discover: Connectivity & Networks, Power & Performance, Privacy & Security, Developer Tools, Sound & Interruptions, and Device Controls

Added redesigned expanded island content for supported system events, including Bluetooth, VPN, ADB, wireless debugging, hotspot, airplane mode, DND, battery saver, NFC, location, flashlight, data saver, auto-rotate, thermal, ringer, and device lock states
Improved expanded island information for Wi-Fi, USB/OTG, charging, and other supported system events
Added adaptive expanded-event layouts with height-aware content sizing and notch-safe spacing
Improved assistant chat navigation with a dedicated chat-history entry point and a contextual actions menu
Improved assistant chat presentation with a fixed header and input area, scrollable conversation content, and clearer message styling
Added or refined live previews for settings that affect island appearance and assistant controls
Added grouped event and settings controls for a more consistent settings experience
Added immersive download progress that fills the expanded island from left to right
Added Wavy, Dotted, and Expressive download progress bar styles
bugfixes: Fixed duplicate information in the Wi-Fi expanded island
Fixed Wi-Fi expanded content overflowing or being clipped at the bottom of the island
Fixed expanded system-event content not adapting correctly to different island heights
Fixed expanded event layouts overlapping or being positioned too close to the camera notch
Fixed system-event content backgrounds and nested containers causing inconsistent expanded-island presentation
Fixed permission information and status presentation so microphone access is represented in both the Permissions tab and permission details
Removed the obsolete Headphones system event and Audio Output implementation
Removed outdated headphone and audio-output references from the documented system-event feature list
Fixed duplicate download percentage text and progress bars extending beneath the icon
improvements: Redesigned expanded system-event cards with clearer information hierarchy, more expressive layouts, and consistent visual treatment
Made expanded system-event layouts vertically responsive so content fits within the available island height
Added safe top spacing for the camera notch while keeping expanded content anchored and balanced
Grouped related System Events settings instead of presenting every event as one flat list
Improved the Profile and settings button groups with consistent connected corner radii
Improved assistant tab layout and interaction organization
Improved notification icon appearance with a brief blur-to-clear entrance transition
Updated README documentation with current system-event coverage, runtime permissions, microphone usage, accessibility-service behaviour, updater permissions, and privacy disclosures
Clarified that notification content is processed on-device, while Assistant messages and relevant conversation context are sent to the AI provider configured by the user when the Assistant is used
Clarified local API-key protection, voice-input behaviour, and the conditions under which accessibility text inspection is used
Updated app version metadata to version 0.1.7 with version code 6
Improved download expanded layout with progress aligned beneath file details and a single optional percentage
Restored the circular progress ring in the compact download pill

description: Expressive Island — refined island interactions, smarter assistant controls, and a more polished settings experience
features: Added expanded battery information with detailed battery status and charging information
Added system event support for more device states and system actions
Added notification timestamps, full notification text, source app labels, and notification testing options
Added configurable notification behaviour for silent notifications, DND, and notification alerts
Added dynamic color controls for system events and notification appearance, including per-app fallback colors
Added Shizuku integration with status-bar, system-alert, and permission controls
Added page transition options, haptic feedback controls, Split Island behaviour, and configurable satellite positioning
Added notification dismissal controls and improved event appearance controls
Added a camera-cutout activity ring for media playback and ongoing progress, including configurable appearance, size, opacity, and colors
Added seekable music progress controls with support for circular progress interaction
Added assistant response display in the cutout with configurable collapsed and expanded timeouts
Added persistent assistant timeout preferences with settings export and import support
Added searchable language selection in a bottom sheet and Hindi and Marathi translations across Profile and Settings
Added a new Expressive Island app identity and updated project branding
Improved the Apps settings layout with consistent horizontal spacing and vertically aligned search and filter controls
Improved the Events, Behaviour, Animation, Shizuku, Dynamic Tiles, and Profile settings screens with clearer organization and localized text
Improved music playback progress accuracy, seeking behaviour, and progress recovery after pausing
Improved camera-ring positioning and transition behaviour so the ring remains centered on the physical cutout
Improved assistant response handling so completed responses automatically dismiss instead of remaining visible indefinitely
bugfixes: Fixed duplicate satellite rendering between music and timer dynamic tiles
Fixed album artwork recovery after the MediaSession listener is rebound
Fixed custom expanded height being incorrectly applied to the expanded music player
Fixed notification display options and various Dynamic Island interaction issues
Fixed satellite ring color resolution, initial preference state, and restoration of normal indicators when the ring is disabled
Fixed assistant timeout compilation by avoiding unsafe smart casts of delegated properties
Fixed Apps settings search and filter alignment and restored consistent page spacing
Fixed the Shizuku back-pill title and appearance-effect corner grouping
Fixed settings layout changes leaking into screens outside the Apps page
